programme: SMAD7, NFATC3, ETS1 and LITAF converge on a myeloid–Treg immunosuppressive tumour-microenvironment axis: LITAF and NFATC3 both transcriptionally target TNF, driving NF-κB-linked macrophage/chemokine output (LITAF also targets CCL2, CXCL12); SMAD7 restrains TGF-β-driven immunogenic cell death and pushes macrophages toward a lactate-dependent, tumour-supportive phenotype; ETS1 sits on the same axis via Treg-associated and matrix/invasion target genes (MMP1, MMP7, SERPINE1, NOS2). Together they describe TGF-β/NFAT/ETS-shaped myeloid polarisation feeding a TNF-centred inflammatory loop.
role_in_a: In colorectal cancer this axis is documented directly: SMAD7 suppresses immunogenic cell death and drives lactate-dependent macrophage phenotype switching, NFATC3 promotes colitis-associated CRC and is blocked to ameliorate AOM/DSS-induced colitis-CRC, and LITAF regulates FOXO1–SIRT1 to control stemness and metastasis. ETS1 has no direct CRC citation in this record, so its CRC role here is inferred from its target network (MMP7, MMP1, SERPINE1) rather than shown.
role_in_b: In lung cancer, SMAD7 is implicated in macrophage-myofibroblast transition within the tumour microenvironment, NFATC3 appears among immune-related prognostic biomarkers in lung squamous cell carcinoma, and ETS1 features both as a key gene in lung cancer/COPD/IPF signatures and in a single-cell study of circulating Treg identification in lung cancer. LITAF has no direct lung citation and a markedly lower Open Targets percentile in lung (0.29) than in CRC (0.11), so its lung role is the weak link.
shared_axis: Colorectal and lung tumours are anatomically unrelated but both depend on TGF-β/NFAT-shaped myeloid and Treg populations to blunt antitumour immunity; a TNF-centred macrophage-polarising loop (LITAF/NFATC3) layered on TGF-β restraint of immunogenic death (SMAD7) and Treg/invasion gene control (ETS1) is a plausible convergent solution to the same immune-evasion problem in both stromal-rich tumour types.
reasoning: Three of the four carrying factors (SMAD7, NFATC3, ETS1) are independently placed by primary papers in both diseases, not just one, and the module (TGF-β/NFAT/ETS-driven macrophage-Treg-TNF signalling) is nameable directly from their target sets, satisfying the bar for strong. The verdict is 'supported' rather than 'established' because no retrieved paper states a CRC-lung shared axis as a fact — each disease's involvement is shown separately and the cross-disease link is a reasoned extension of established solid-tumour immunology.
support: 42650029 — SMAD7 drives lactate-dependent macrophage phenotype in CRC; 40213961 — Smad7 negatively regulates immunogenic cell death in CRC; 41690032 — SMAD7-linked macrophage-myofibroblast transition targeted in NSCLC; 36064319 — Nfatc3 mediates ulcerative-colitis-associated CRC via Pou3f1; 32653643 — blocking NFATc3 ameliorates colitis-associated CRC; 41562084 — NFATC3 among immune-related prognostic biomarkers in lung squamous cell carcinoma; 42230551 — joint single-cell Treg study spanning lung cancer implicating ETS1; 41855208 — ETS1 identified as key gene in lung cancer/COPD/IPF; 37266842 — LITAF regulates FOXO1-SIRT1 to inhibit CRC stemness/metastasis.
how_to_falsify: In matched CRC and NSCLC tumour-organoid/macrophage co-culture systems, knock down SMAD7 and NFATC3 together and measure TNF output and macrophage polarisation (e.g. lactate-dependent marker shift) alongside Treg induction; if the TNF/macrophage-Treg response is unaffected in either tumour type, or if LITAF and NFATC3 show no co-occupancy at the TNF locus by ChIP/CUT&RUN in tumour-infiltrating myeloid cells from both cancers, the shared-axis claim fails.
caveats: 532 patient-group comparisons from 2 independent cohort pairs is a broad base, but concordance for the carrying factors sits at 33-37% of comparisons (170-197/532), not near-universal, so treat the module as recurrent rather than dominant. The single-view exclusion list correctly rules out CTNNB1 (the canonical Wnt/CRC driver) and TFDP1 (an E2F/cell-cycle partner) as story elements — neither was invoked here, consistent with the exclusion. No tissue-generic exclusion list was supplied for this pair. LITAF's lung role and ETS1's CRC role are the weakest points, resting on target-network inference rather than direct citation; KMT2A/HCFC1 (a genuine chromatin/E2F cell-cycle complex), the ATF4/ATF1/GABPA ferroptosis-response cluster, and the lineage-identity factors NKX2-1, KLF1 and PAX5 were left out of carrying_factors because they form distinct, non-overlapping mechanistic stories that this account does not attempt to unify.
